title: Conditional types and infer interview drills

items.question: Implement ReturnType<T> using conditional types and infer.
items.answer: type ReturnType<T> = T extends (...args: never[]) => infer R ? R : never. infer R captures return type when T matches callable shape. Works on typeof fn. Compile time only — erased in JS output.
items.sixtySeconds: T extends (...args) => infer R ? R : never. infer only in extends clause. typeof for functions.

items.question: What is a distributive conditional type? Give an example pitfall.
items.answer: When T is naked union parameter, T extends U ? X : Y distributes over each member. ToArray<T> = T extends any ? T[] : never over string|number gives string[]|number[] not (string|number)[]. Fix: [T] extends [any] ? T[] : never.
items.sixtySeconds: Naked union distributes. Exclude uses never filter. Bracket T to disable. string array pitfall.

items.question: Implement Awaited<T> — explain recursion.
items.answer: If T null|undefined return T. If T thenable with then(onfulfilled: infer F), infer F extends (v: infer V) => unknown ? Awaited<V> : never. Else return T. Recursively unwraps Promise<Promise<string>> to string. Matches lib.es5.
items.sixtySeconds: Recursive conditional infer V. null preserved. thenable pattern. Types only not runtime.

items.question: Implement Exclude<T, U> and explain distribution.
items.answer: type Exclude<T, U> = T extends U ? never : T. For T = A|B|C, evaluates per member, removes matches with never, unions rest. Filters union members at type level — runtime needs filter.
items.sixtySeconds: T extends U ? never : T distributes. Filters union. Extract keeps matches. NonNullable drops null undefined.

items.question: When would you use template literal types in production?
items.answer: Type-safe event names on${Capitalize<Event>}, HTTP method + path routes, CSS property keys, Redis key prefixes as template types. Compile-time string validation — still need runtime check for external input.
items.sixtySeconds: Type-level string concat. Event maps route keys. Erased at runtime. Validate external strings separately.

items.question: infer can only appear where?
items.answer: Only in the extends clause of a conditional type — T extends SomePattern<infer U> ? U : never. Cannot use infer at top level. Scoped to conditional where declared. Multiple infer in one clause must unify.
items.sixtySeconds: infer only in extends of conditional. ReturnType Parameters Awaited. Not runtime.
